mentions.name: Bridge Designer web port
mentions.description: A web port of the Bridge Designer, built as an HS senior capstone project. Bridges are currently rendered statically and the load simulation works in code, though load visualizations are not yet implemented; the author plans to post it when ready.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my HS senior capstone project: Porting the Bridge Designer[0] to the web.  So far we've got bridges rendered statically and the load simulation working in code (no load visualisations yet).  I intend to post it here when it's ready.
